rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for being anxious or worrying about someone or something.

example.english: I really worry about them going home alone at night.
example.traditional: 我真係擔心佢一個人夜晚返屋企。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zan1 hai6 daam1 sam1 keoi5 jat1 go3 jan4 je6 maan5 faan1 uk1 kei2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a troubling feeling or the thing causing it.

example.english: Unemployment is my biggest worry lately.
example.traditional: 失業係我最近最大嘅煩惱。
example.jyutping: sat1 jip6 hai6 ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 zeoi3 daai6 ge3 faan4 nou5

rows.note: Use this for a personal or private worry that is weighing on someone’s mind.

example.english: They have a private worry and cannot sleep all night.
example.traditional: 佢有心事，成晚都瞓唔着。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jau5 sam1 si6 sing4 maan5 dou1 fan3 m4 zoek6

rows.note: Use this causative construction when a person or situation makes A feel worried.

example.english: This news made me worry all night.
example.traditional: 呢單新聞令我擔心咗成晚。
example.jyutping: ni1 daan1 san1 man4 ling6 ngo5 daam1 sam1 zo2 seng4 maan5
